reason: Six font sizes cover display, title, section, body, secondary and label roles without ad hoc steps. DOM area estimates are proxies and require state-bound screenshot review. Non-hero gradients and backdrop filters are signals for the critic, not automatic fails.
focusStateContrastReason: Screening threshold for the focus heuristic: a focus indicator (outline, border, underline, ring, or background/text change) counts only when it reaches this contrast against the unfocused state or its backdrop. 3:1 is derived from WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.13 Focus Appearance (AAA) and matches the SC 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast (AA) minimum, which is the floor: the checker refuses a value below 3. It is a screen, not proof of 2.4.7/2.4.13; manual focus review stays mandatory.
spacingOffScaleReason: At handoff every visible padding, vertical margin and row/column gap must resolve to a value on the built --spacing-* scale (0 always allowed). Horizontal margins are not counted because auto margins resolve to pixels. Wireframes are not gated. A screen, not proof of good rhythm.
